title: fr-splitting-types widget params
description: The splitting type of an unramified prime p in a Galois extension K/Q of degree n. Pick n and a divisor pair (r,f) with rf=n; the widget shows the factorization pO_K = P_1···P_r into r primes each of residue degree f, draws Frobenius as r disjoint f-cycles (its cycle shape on the n roots), and reports the factorization of f-bar(x) into r distinct degree-f irreducibles over F_p, the order f of Frobenius, and the name: completely split (r=n,f=1, Frob=identity), inert (r=1,f=n, Frob an n-cycle), or partially split.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.
